decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range builds on the firm's established pharmacy consumer health offer and fits its strategy of broadening the portfolio, so with no sign of a shortfall against aspirations it is kept.
The skin and hair supplement is a low-cost line extension sold through the firm's pharmacy channel, and the slack of a growing firm lets it carry the product despite uncertain results.
The joint health supplement was promoted on its own page by 2019 and serves an established, ageing demand, so it likely meets aspirations and needs no problemistic search.
The immune supplement probably benefited from higher demand for immune products during the pandemic, so it performs at or above aspiration.

The 2018 Valsartan contamination recall was a clear shortfall that likely triggered problemistic search, but generic blood pressure drugs are a core high-volume market under insurer contracts, so the firm more likely keeps the product with a corrected active-ingredient source.
The over-the-counter triptan fits the firm's strategy of expanding into consumer health, has a niche pharmacy demand, and is too new to be judged a failure.
